name: recoil_app_mission_fmv_on_update_should_quit
description: RecoilApp_MissionFmvState::OnUpdateShouldQuit advances the mission FMV script when active and queues the play state when skipped or finished.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target currently covers this RecoilApp mission-FMV state method.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly and HLIL for 0x42ee70 show the skip flag bypasses zFMV_Script::UpdateAtTime, the non-skipped branch queues only when UpdateAtTime returns zero, and all paths return zero.

The native smoke verifies the skipped branch queues g_RecoilApp.m_playState without touching a sentinel FMV action pointer, an active wait action leaves the state queue empty, and an empty finished script queues g_RecoilApp.m_playState.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x42ee70 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
